title: Unit Converter Drill
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Set a joint position in raw steps, degrees, radians or percent and see the other three units for a calibrated range you choose. Then calculate six conversions yourself and type the answers. Used in Chapter 10.

educational.topic: Converting between raw servo steps, degrees, radians and percent with a joint calibration
learningObjectives: Calculate conversions between raw servo steps, degrees, radians and percent for a calibrated joint, to within 0.1 degree, 0.001 radian, 1 step or 0.1 percent as asked, in six problems, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Repeated calculation on new numbers with one fixed calibration, each answer checked at once against a stated tolerance, with the working shown
keyQuestions: What is the middle of this range, and what angle is it?
What happens to a target that lies beyond the end of the range?
commonMisconceptions: The same raw number means the same angle on every joint
A target beyond the range moves the joint beyond it
assessmentOpportunities: Six typed numeric answers, one attempt each, checked against a tolerance; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: Value
controls.range: raw 0 to 4095 step 1 (default 1992); degrees -180 to 180; radians -3.14 to 3.14; percent 0 to 100
